    • connectionRMI

      public void connectionRMI(boolean isReconnecting, ClientRMI clientRMI) throws NotBoundException, IOException
      Establishes a connection to the RMI server and handles the client login process with support for reconnection.
      Specified by:
      connectionRMI in interface UserInterface
      Parameters:
      isReconnecting - specifies whether the client is attempting to reconnect to the server.
      clientRMI - an instance of ClientRMI representing the RMI client logic to interact with the server.
      Throws:
      NotBoundException - if the requested binding is not found in the registry.
      IOException - if an error occurs during communication with the server.

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      Starts the game by handling user input and graphical updates asynchronously. Manages input commands like "quit" and "reconnect" while also rendering graphics. Utilizes multiple threads to maintain separate input processing and rendering tasks.

    • insertRandomTiles

      public void insertRandomTiles(int numberOfTiles)
      Inserts a specified number of random tiles into the player's shipboard, adhering to game rules and constraints. Attempts to place, rotate, and draw tiles in randomized locations and orientations if allowed. Recursively continues until the specified number of tiles are placed or the shipboard is full.
      Parameters:
      numberOfTiles - the number of tiles to be randomly inserted onto the shipboard; must be a positive integer
